events.title: Claude 3 Opus released
events.summary: Anthropic joined the frontier-model race with strong long-context and safety-oriented positioning.

narrative.whyChosen: It marked the shift from one-vendor LLM hype to a multi-company frontier competition.
narrative.whyImportant: Competition increased release cadence, improved benchmarks, and made model choice a product decision.
narrative.problemSolved: Teams wanted alternatives to a single LLM provider for capability, pricing, safety posture, and vendor risk.
